- Dark themed responsive layout: header with title, main grid with left column (canvas display + ROM/source info + controls), right column (debugger panel + keypad).
- All CSS inline in <style>, all JS inline in <script>. No CDN, no fetch, no backend.

EMULATOR CORE (implement ALL 35 CHIP-8 opcodes)
- 4096 bytes memory, fontset (80 bytes, 16 glyphs 0-F, standard COSMAC font) loaded at 0x050, programs at 0x200.
- 16 8-bit registers V0-VF, 16-bit index I, PC, 16-level stack + stack pointer, delay timer DT and sound timer ST decremented at 60Hz (separate from CPU loop, use a 60Hz timer accumulator inside the RAF loop).
- Display 64x32, XOR sprite drawing with VF collision flag, wrapping sprite pixels (clip or wrap x/y — use wrap for x and y within display).
- Opcodes: 00E0 CLS, 00EE RET, 0nnn SYS (ignore), 1nnn JP, 2nnn CALL, 3xkk SE, 4xkk SNE, 5xy0 SE, 6xkk LD, 7xkk ADD (no carry), 8xy0-8xyE (LD, OR, AND, XOR, ADD w/ carry, SUB w/ borrow VF, SHR, SUBN w/ borrow VF, SHL), 9xy0 SNE, Annn LD I, Bnnn JP V0, Cxkk RND, Dxyn DRW, Ex9E SKP, ExA1 SKNP, Fx07 LD Vx,DT, Fx0A LD Vx,K (wait for key press AND release), Fx15 LD DT,Vx, Fx18 LD ST,Vx, Fx1E ADD I,Vx, Fx29 LD F,Vx, Fx33 LD B,Vx (BCD), Fx55 LD [I],Vx (store V0..Vx), Fx65 LD Vx,[I] (load V0..Vx).
- Shift instructions 8xy6/8xyE must shift VY into VX per modern/SUPER-CHIP? No — use the ORIGINAL COSMAC behavior: shift VX in place (Vx >>= 1 / <<= 1), and 8xy4/8xy5/8xy7 use Vx = Vx op Vy with VF set. Also 8xy1/8xy2/8xy3 should NOT reset VF (original behavior). Add a toggle checkbox "Shift uses VY (SCHIP quirk)" and "Logic ops reset VF (quirk)" — actually keep it simpler: just implement original COSMAC behavior, and add two checkboxes for the two common quirks (shift source, load/store increment I). Make sure they work.
- Fx55/Fx65: I is left unchanged (original) but add quirk checkbox "Increment I after Fx55/Fx65".

DISPLAY
- <canvas> 64x32 backing resolution scaled up via CSS (image-rendering: pixelated) to ~640x320 or responsive width. Draw with fillRect in a render function; support two color themes (green phosphor / amber) selectable by a color <select> that actually changes colors.
- Draw a subtle grid overlay option (checkbox).

KEYPAD
- 4x4 grid of buttons labeled with the CHIP-8 hex keys 1 2 3 C / 4 5 6 D / 7 8 9 E / A 0 B F.
- Map keyboard: 1,2,3,4 -> keys 1,2,3,C; Q,W,E,R -> 4,5,6,D; A,S,D,F -> 7,8,9,E; Z,X,C,V -> A,0,B,F (standard mapping).
- Handle keydown and keyup (preventDefault for mapped keys), also pointerdown/pointerup/pointerleave on the on-screen buttons so mouse/touch works. Highlight pressed keys visually.
- The key state array drives SKP/SKNP and Fx0A (Fx0A: wait until a key goes down then up, register the key on release).

CONTROLS (all must work)
- Run / Pause (toggle, two buttons or one toggling with state), Step (executes exactly 1 instruction when paused), Reset (full reset + reload current ROM), Speed slider (instructions per frame, 1..500, log-ish or linear, with numeric readout), ROM file input (<input type=file accept=.ch8,.rom>), "Load Demo" button, and a "Sound" toggle (WebAudio square-wave beep while ST>0, created lazily on first user gesture).

DEMO ROM
- Hand-assemble a real CHIP-8 program as a JS Uint8Array/number array literal named DEMO_ROM. It must: clear screen, draw a sprite (use font glyph drawing or a custom 5-byte sprite), respond to keys 4/6 (or 2/8) to move the sprite left/right/up/down, redraw each frame, clamp to screen bounds, and use DT-based delay for movement pacing (e.g. wait loop reading DT). Include a border/frame drawn at start, and display instructions in the debugger area. Verify the byte encoding is correct (opcodes like 6xkk, Annn, DxyN, 3xkk, 1nnn, 00E0, Fx07, Fx15 etc.).

DEBUGGER PANEL
- Registers V0-VF in a grid with hex values, highlighted when changed since last step.
- I (index), PC, SP, DT, ST, current opcode (hex), decoded disassembly of current instruction (human readable, e.g. "8xy4 ADD V3, V4 (carry)"), stack contents (hex list), and a small memory/program listing around PC (8-12 lines with addresses, hex bytes, disassembly, current line marker).
- Update on every step/pause/reset. Auto-refresh while running (throttled ok).

EXTRAS
- Show FPS / IPS readout.
- Disassembler function used by both debugger and listing.
- Sound via AudioContext oscillator gated by ST.
- Everything must work with zero external requests.

Deliver as the single file `chip8_ollama-mimo-v2.6-flash-rl-mxfp4_01.html`."}
